 Nathan Aké forced off early for Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray availability uncertain 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Nathan Aké lasted only 18 minutes of Fenerbahçe’s Champions League meeting with Slavia Prague in Istanbul after suffering an early injury.
 Oguz Aydin and Mason Greenwood put Fenerbahçe 2-0 ahead inside 11 minutes. According to Goal.com, Aké then sat down in pain with his knee and was unable to continue as team-mates called for a change.
 OneFootball Videos
 Slavia Prague quickly hit back.
 The Netherlands defender walked off unaided and did not require a stretcher. The problem does not appear serious, although he still needs a medical examination.
 The setback leaves Aké waiting to discover whether he will be fit for next Monday’s derby with Galatasaray. The 62-cap international signed a three-year contract in Türkiye last summer and has made 18 appearances for Fenerbahçe.
 Source: Goal.com
